steps.who: Your primary care team, or Kaiser Member Services if you need help finding one
steps.say: I want an appointment about a health concern. How do I arrange a visit with a plan provider?
steps.why: Confirm the appropriate appointment and provider for your concern.

steps.say: I want a preventive checkup. Which planned services qualify as preventive under my plan? Could any other services have a separate charge?
steps.why: Confirm how the planned services will be billed; not everything provided during a checkup is necessarily preventive.

steps.who: Kaiser Member Services or the mental health scheduling team
steps.say: I want to start outpatient mental health therapy. How do I schedule an initial visit with a plan provider, and is any referral needed for this service?
steps.why: Ask for the correct access route rather than assuming the general specialist referral rule applies.

steps.say: Will this be an individual or group therapy visit, and what charges apply to that appointment?
steps.why: Confirm the appointment type before using its benefit amount.

steps.who: Your primary care team or Kaiser Member Services
steps.say: For the specialty I need, can I book directly or do I need a referral? If a referral is needed, who arranges it?
steps.fallbackSay: For the specialty I need, do I need a referral or can I book directly? Who can help me arrange it?

steps.who: Kaiser Member Services or the provider billing team
steps.say: Can you confirm these benefits apply to my planned visit or service with this provider, and whether any additional services will be billed?
steps.why: For a plan provider: {service_cost} Deductible rule: {deductible_rule}
steps.fallbackSay: What would I pay for this specific service with this provider? Does my deductible apply, and could there be separate charges?

steps.who: The clinician or care team that ordered your test
steps.say: Where should I get my ordered test? Is the order on file at that location, and is the location a plan provider?
steps.why: Confirm the order and location before scheduling.

steps.say: Does this particular test need prior authorization? If so, who handles it and has it been approved? Are there any preparation instructions?
steps.why: Confirm any approval and preparation requirements for the specific test.

steps.who: Kaiser Member Services or the imaging billing team
steps.say: Can I get an estimate for my ordered MRI at this location using my remaining deductible? Does the estimate include all charges, including interpretation?
steps.why: A coinsurance percentage alone does not establish your personal dollar cost.

steps.who: The ordering care team or laboratory billing team
steps.say: Are my ordered blood tests being billed as diagnostic tests or covered preventive services? Can you confirm the applicable benefit and any additional charges?
steps.why: The diagnostic lab benefit for a plan provider is: {service_cost} Deductible rule: {deductible_rule}
steps.fallbackSay: Are these blood tests diagnostic or covered preventive services? What would I pay at this laboratory, and does my deductible apply?
